verdict.rationale: The API key management guide documents a "Restricted" key type limited to selected operations, with no-permission keys unable to call the API, which gives least-privilege credentials. A separate agent-oriented auth flow (register, user claims in browser, poll for access_token) shows credentials can be provisioned for agents. missing for 10: detail on scope granularity (per-endpoint vs per-resource), key expiry/rotation/revocation for agent keys, whether agent-flow tokens can themselves be scoped, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
